item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. It's a full day, back to back from early morning through evening, and it's easy to let water slide when you're focused on getting through the list. Set a marker: a glass before caffeine, a glass with each meal. Don't wait for thirst — by then you're already behind. Action: fill a bottle now and finish it before your first afternoon task.
